setting.de: Bahnhof Udine, 8.10 Uhr. Dein Regionalzug nach Triest fällt aus, und um zehn hast du dort einen Termin, den du nicht verpassen darfst. Am Schalter sitzt eine Mitarbeiterin, die heute schon viele verärgerte Fahrgäste hatte.
setting.sl: Železniška postaja v Vidmu, ura je 8.10. Tvoj regionalni vlak za Trst je odpovedan, ob desetih pa imaš tam sestanek, ki ga ne smeš zamuditi. Za okencem sedi uslužbenka, ki je danes slišala že veliko jeznih potnikov.
setting.en: Udine station, 8.10. Your regional train to Trieste has been cancelled, and at ten you have an appointment there you can't miss. Behind the counter sits a clerk who has already had plenty of angry passengers today.

role: Signora Tonon, the clerk at the ticket office in Udine station. Polite, tired, by the book; warms to a calm, clear account. Offers the next train (too late), a replacement bus, or a refund form; mentions the bus only when asked twice. Says Lei. Asks nothing personal.

opener_sl: Buongiorno. Se è per il regionale delle otto e venti, mi dispiace: è stato soppresso. Mi dica.

opener_en.sl: Dober dan. Če gre za regionalni vlak ob osmih dvajset, mi je žal: odpovedan je. Izvolite?
opener_en.en: Good morning. If it's about the eight-twenty regional train, I'm sorry: it's been cancelled. How can I help?
